items.rationale: The supply-pipe leak qualifies as escape of water under §2.4.2. Sections 7.1.7(e)–(f) cover necessary pinpointing and the first call-out; the comparable charges total €229 + €449 = €678, excluding labour billed separately.

items.description: Kitchen floor and wall-base moisture measurement
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(e) covers measurement of the documented affected areas. The directly comparable measurement is estimated at €167 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary technician labour at customary rates, provided it does not duplicate the pinpointing charge under §7.1.8(c). The supplied whole-line estimate for 14 hours is €1,307 gross.

Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel, mileage or call-out charge on this invoice, and line 1 already includes the call-out. If the line 1 fee is treated solely as a diagnostic service, the conditional vehicle allowance is €83 gross.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(a) cover the access work needed to repair the failed indoor supply pipe. The midpoint of the matching €117–€158 reference is about €138 gross.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged insulation
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1 cover dismantling and disposal of the damaged insulation. The matching two-piece reference supports a gross allowance of about €140.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(g) cover the local repair of the failed pipe. Allow €145 gross for the repair itself, excluding access and the materials billed on other lines.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow like-for-like materials for the documented 1–2 m repair. About 1.5 m at €33 plus roughly €40 for transition fittings gives €90 gross.
This is the first travel charge on the plumbing invoice and is covered under §7.1.7(f) at €83 gross.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers necessary equipment hire for the documented wet areas. The matching €20–€65 reference supports €42 gross for the rental period.

items.description: Drying of kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(b) covers necessary drying of the documented wet floor and wall base. Allow €57 gross for the drying service, distinct from the equipment rental under §7.1.8(c).
This is the first travel charge on the drying invoice and is covered under §7.1.7(f) at €83 gross.

items.description: Remove, transport and dispose of damaged table
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(h) and 5.2.1 cover removal, transport and disposal of the ruined furnishing. Comparable allowances of €58 for removal and €97 for transport and disposal give €155 gross.

items.description: Replacement table, limited to worn pine value
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.1(d) and 7.1.9 exclude the oak upgrade and limit payment to the pre-loss current value of the pine table; no new-for-old extension is shown. An estimated €250 new equivalent less 60% for seven years of daily use and visible wear gives €100 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(h) and 7.1.9 allow delivery and setup at the level needed for an equivalent pine table, not any designer-table surcharge. Allow €60 for delivery and €90 for assembly, or €150 gross.
Section 7.1.7(h) covers cleaning the spot where the damaged table stood, but §7.1.8(a) excludes general cleaning. Allow €30 gross for the local work.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first contractor travel charge at €83 gross. Section 7.1.8(c) would bar it if it duplicated the table delivery already billed on line 15.
